نبذة

The Space Beauty Lounge is a unique concept of Salon, Spa and Boutique with Cafe' located in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates. A one-of-a-kind gathering and relaxation haven to escape for a moment of pampering and relaxation. The Space Beauty Lounge Boutique aims to support local brands, a place to shop and a place to explore local talent and creativity. The space to pamper your spirit!

A visit to The Space Beauty Lounge is marked by attentive care and a welcoming atmosphere, with clients enjoying a comfortable experience from arrival through treatment. The skilled therapists are particularly praised for relaxing body massages that ease muscle tension, while classic manicures and pedicures receive careful attention from the nail technicians, leaving clients feeling well cared for.
